title: HOUSE / FIELD
purpose: Canonical public-safe HOUSE instrument: one addressed dwelling locus projected through spatial/state/design views, a contextual reality-harness index around that locus, truthful timestamped runtime witness depth, and private actuation authority in Home Assistant / HOUSEBUS.

current_surface.kind: contextual spatial/state/design workbench with reality-harness aperture
current_surface.semantics: One addressed object, many unequal projections. REALITY ◎ indexes neighboring physical/computational layers without changing identity or authority. Selection/local authored state do not imply presence or actuation.

forbidden_classes: vendor device identifiers that function as credentials
enforcement: The generator builds the public document by whitelist and then scans the serialized JSON for forbidden patterns; it refuses to write on any match. The committed state.json carries its own sanitization result.
kernel_role: OBJECT -> ADDRESS -> PROJECT -> bounded DESIGN/TRIAL -> WITNESS -> RETURN at canonical /house/. REALITY ◎ supplies layer/project re-entry around the same address. OPERATE remains private Home Assistant / HOUSEBUS.

spatial_state.relation: Spatial State Engine supplies ADDRESS/PROJECT semantics; Home Assistant / HOUSEBUS retains OPERATE authority.
spatial_state.thin_slice: 2D room/object graph + manual state + explicit HA entity mapping; add sensors only where they remove real friction.

body_bridge.receives: 0xxx0.body.field.latest.v01 (latest local BODY return for local display only)
body_bridge.emits: 0xxx0.house.body.context.v0.1 from canonical /house/: selected spatial address + timestamped public HOUSE projection metadata, browser-local only; includes read-time snapshot_freshness when available
body_bridge.authority: context only; selected HOUSE address is not presence or causation, does not write BODY observations into house/state.json, and grants no actuation authority
body_bridge.privacy: personal BODY state remains browser-local; no public projection includes it

reality_task_boundary.rule: Ordinary chores and personal task state are not canonical HOUSE state.
reality_task_boundary.private_execution: Route chores/maintenance obligations into browser-local Dayline or another private runtime surface.
reality_task_boundary.returns_to_house: Only durable physical/resource/state evidence returns to HOUSE (for example an adopted item, changed spatial address, verified device mapping, or completed maintenance that materially changes represented state).
reality_task_boundary.public_repo: Do not commit private chore lists, presence, schedules, or personal urgency to the public HOUSE projection.

expert_projection.generator: private normalizer in the HOUSEBUS repository (scripts/project-public.py)
expert_projection.refresh: manual: run the generator, then commit regenerated state.json
expert_projection.authority: read-only projection; never a control endpoint

shopping_fit_bridge.input: exact Shopping candidate identity/state + BODY/OPERATING envelope + optional source-owned evidence signal/proof boundary
shopping_fit_bridge.operation: compare candidate operating W/D/H against explicit user-entered available W/D/H at selected HOUSE address, with optional 90° plan rotation
shopping_fit_bridge.output: OFFER_ONLY / EVIDENCE_ONLY fit result containing selected HOUSE address, candidate/available dimensions and PASS_ENVELOPE | FAIL_ENVELOPE | MEASURE_REQUIRED | UNKNOWN_CANDIDATE
shopping_fit_bridge.authority: HOUSE owns dimensional screen only; Shopping owns candidate/lifecycle; return cannot purchase, install, promote ownership or adoption, and cannot mutate canonical HOUSE geometry or HA/HOUSEBUS
shopping_fit_bridge.semantic_signal: source-owned Shopping pattern is rendered as projection only; HOUSE does not combine/reclassify it
shopping_fit_bridge.return: exact Shopping item explicitly revalidates and accepts fit receipt; changed item/state becomes stale/read-only

design_trial.address_binding: current canonical HOUSE selected address + projection
design_trial.sequence: BEFORE -> INTENT -> CHANGE -> CONSTRAINTS -> VERIFY -> AFTER -> DECISION -> RESIDUE -> RETURN
design_trial.return_gate: BEFORE, INTENT, CHANGE, VERIFY, AFTER and DECISION required; otherwise fail closed
design_trial.optional_evidence: current house-shopping-fit-return/v0.1 may attach as evidence-only dimensional context
design_trial.authority: local design reasoning/receipt only; no canonical geometry mutation, HA/HOUSEBUS actuation, structural/safety/code approval or purchase/install authority
design_trial.promotion: canonical geometry/state changes require independent measurement/evidence update; permanent work keeps external structural/services/code gates where relevant

reality_harness.visible_operation: REALITY ◎ opens a contextual aperture around the current selected HOUSE address
reality_harness.physical_layers: BODY -> HARNESS -> OBJECT -> ROOM -> HOUSE -> NETWORK
reality_harness.env0_interpretation: ENV-0 is a recovered human body-house coupling/harness lineage. Its analogy to agent harnesses is bounded to context/capability/constraint/witness/RETURN; actor identities and authorities remain unequal.
reality_harness.authority: projection/navigation only; no geometry, HA/HOUSEBUS, agent, medical, structural, procurement or social authority

runtime_witness.rule: Freshness is recomputed from generated_at at read time. Embedded source_age_class/runtime_health_class describe the source/runtime at generation time only.
runtime_witness.authority: timestamped public-safe projection only; never live presence/safety/actuation truth
runtime_witness.refresh_boundary: Actual content refresh still requires the private HOUSEBUS whitelist normalizer plus access to current runtime source.
